parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, typically made of stainless steel or tempered glass, designed to cover the pot and retain heat and moisture.
parts.Functional_description: The lid helps to trap steam and heat inside the pot, allowing for faster cooking and better flavor retention. It may also prevent splattering.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or placed on top of the pot; it is detachable and does not have any mechanical movement.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of aluminum for good heat conduction and lightweight handling.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds food and liquids for cooking. It distributes heat evenly across its surface and may include handles for safe handling.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is stationary during use but can be moved or lifted by the handles when cooking or serving.
